1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.e5 Nd5 4.Nc3 e6 5.Nx.strategy: Removes Black's most active piece; Black normally recaptures with the pawn. White keeps the e5 pawn as a cramping spearhead and prepares to strike at the centre at once.
The natural recapture: Black gets pawns on c5 and d5 against White's e5 and a share of the centre, but those pawns will be under pressure.
